verdict.rationale: Expensify documents instant answers and charts for anything in the account, such as monthly spend (Ask Expensify AI). SmartScan extracts receipt data in realtime and auto-categorizes expenses as they're created, then matches receipts to imported card transactions. That supports same-day, category-level visibility. Community reports of frequent miscategorization (~70%) and slow processing temper the category breakdown, though they are anecdotal and not a direct contradiction. Missing for 10: a documented real-time spend dashboard, breakdown by team/department, breakdown by merchant, evidence that card transactions post the day they happen rather than at statement or report time, and independent corroboration.
